{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid molten cannon''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapon upgrade of the standard [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame thrower]]. While this device did shoot wide streams of liquid fire, there were few practical applications requiring such a device and it was primarily sought after by military powers for its devastating effect on enemy morale.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
